newsitem.title: UK: Uruguay's Banco Comercial plans $100 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay's Banco Comercial plans $100 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Uruguay's Banco Comercial S.A. plans to launch a $100 million 10-year Eurobond in the coming weeks, syndicate managers said on Wednesday.
Credit Suisse First Boston was tipped as lead manager on the deal, they said.
Last September Uruguay launched a $100 million 10-year bond via CSFB, which was priced to yield 162.5 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
In December, Moody's Investors Service rated Banco Comercial's senior debt Ba1 and gave it a D+ financial strength rating.
Three foreign banks, Chase, Dresdner and Credit Suisse, each own 17.4 percent of the voting shares in the bank, giving them majority control.
